rows.name:
Villagers often come home injured lately. There[XENO:n ]
are so many injuries that ingredients for medicine[XENO:n ]
are running low. Gather more to treat the injured.

Obtain 5 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Cribe Back Moss[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Oros Cribes on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Vortec.

You obtained the materials for the medicine.[XENO:n ]
But the Machine God Soldiers responsible are still there.

The Machine God Soldiers threatening the village[XENO:n ]
have been located near Thumb Crevasse, it seems.[XENO:n ]
Wipe them out to protect the village.

Near Thumb Crevasse on the Fallen Arm,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Repairing Machine Soldier[/System:Color].
Return to Vortec.

You defeated the soldiers responsible, saving the village.[XENO:n ]
The villagers should be safe from their attacks now.

The silver machine left on the beach is making a noise.[XENO:n ]
Primo says it's too eerie to fetch water for work.[XENO:n ]
Go to the beach and find the source of the noise.

Examine the Silver Wreckage near Wreckage Beach[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Primo.

You found the cause of the noise and reassured[XENO:n ]
Primo. Now she can return to her water fetching.

She reportedly spotted giant Machine God Soldiers[XENO:n ]
while searching around the village for usable parts.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them before they endanger the villagers.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]M85 Meteor Artillery[/System:Color] units[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Elena.

You defeated the giant Machine God Soldiers[XENO:n ]
before any harm came to the villagers.

Perhaps because the giant machines were defeated,[XENO:n ]
other Machine God Soldiers ran amok. They may harm[XENO:n ]
the villagers, so wipe them out to protect the village.

Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]M56 Prototypes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Elena.

You managed to wipe out the Machine God Soldiers.[XENO:n ]
The villagers shouldn't be endangered now.

Orpheus stopped growing at some point. The materials[XENO:n ]
he mentioned could apparently be used to make a device[XENO:n ]
to stimulate growth. Gather the three items first.
Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Transmission Bypass[/System:Color].
Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Exhaust Pump[/System:Color].
Obtain [System:Color name=item ]High-Output Mini Reactor[/System:Color].
Return to Orpheus.

Shulk made the device with the materials you gathered.[XENO:n ]
You delivered it to Orpheus.

Defeat the Enhanced Offensive Unit[XENO:n ]
near Black Wreckage on the Fallen Arm[XENO:n ]
and obtain a Transmission Bypass.

Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Transmission Bypass[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from an Enhanced Offensive Unit.

You defeated the Enhanced Offensive Unit[XENO:n ]
and obtained a Transmission Bypass.

Defeat the Offensive Hover Unit[XENO:n ]
near Machine God Ring Finger on the Fallen Arm[XENO:n ]
and obtain an Exhaust Pump.

Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Exhaust Pump[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from an Offensive Hover Unit.

You defeated the Offensive Hover Unit[XENO:n ]
and obtained an Exhaust Pump.

Defeat the New-Power M86[XENO:n ]
near Index Finger Plain on the Fallen Arm[XENO:n ]
and obtain a High-Output Mini Reactor.

Obtain [System:Color name=item ]High-Output Mini Reactor[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from the New-Power M86.

You defeated the large machine[XENO:n ]
and obtained a High-Output Mini Reactor.

Memory units recording the Machina's former lives[XENO:n ]
are reportedly scattered around Machine God Field.[XENO:n ]
They want their memories back, so retrieve them.

In Machine God Field,[XENO:n ]
obtain 4 [System:Color name=item ]Memory 925 Fragments[/System:Color].
Return to Rillet.

The memory units you brought back seem to have been[XENO:n ]
damaged. Even so, they regained some of their memories.

Their most precious memory unit apparently[XENO:n ]
remains in the capital. You don't know what memory[XENO:n ]
they cherish, but help them reclaim their past.

Near the Judicial District in the capital Agniratha,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Memory 903[/System:Color].
Return to Rillet.

You delivered the memory the villagers wished to recall[XENO:n ]
and brought genuine smiles back to their faces.

Underwater rescue is difficult for a Machina.[XENO:n ]
As a Homs, Rei should be able to rescue people underwater.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials needed to gain a Homs body.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Silver Lexos Hearts[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Lexos on Valak Mountain.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Pretty Flamii Legs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Kukukoro Flamii on the Fallen Arm.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Poisonous Corals[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Rei.

The materials were mixed, but Rei couldn't become a Homs.[XENO:n ]
Rei began considering the next approach.

Monsters have started gathering around the village lately.[XENO:n ]
The cause is unknown, but they can't be ignored.[XENO:n ]
Keep the village safe for those who can't fight!

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]M35 Prototypes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Aura Antols[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Lampo Ponios[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Prado Upas[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Rei.

You defeated the monsters gathering nearby[XENO:n ]
and made the village safe.

The villagers want to protect their home themselves.[XENO:n ]
To do so, they need a special fibre.[XENO:n ]
Obtain it so they can defend their own village.

Obtain 5 strands of [System:Color name=item ]Silver Antol Fibre[/System:Color], a rare drop[XENO:n ]
from Antol on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Rei.

Adding the special fibre to their moving parts made power[XENO:n ]
well up from deep within, strengthening their bodies.

Her front door broke down with age.[XENO:n ]
She doesn't have the materials to repair it.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials so she can enter her home again.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Electric Filaments[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Dated Frames[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from M56 Prototypes on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Leanna.

You delivered the materials and the door was repaired.[XENO:n ]
She can now return to her own home.

With her door repaired, she returned home after[XENO:n ]
ages away to find her treasured mechanical flower[XENO:n ]
wilting. Get what Leanna asked for before it dies.

Near Zakt Spring on the Fallen Arm,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Pure Water[/System:Color].
Return to Leanna.

Obtain 5 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Electric Upa Tears[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Prado Upas on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Leanna.

The flower quickly came back to life.[XENO:n ]
Seeing it, she smiled.

He seems to have lost the sword he swore an oath on[XENO:n ]
with his close friend in the Defence Force.[XENO:n ]
Find it, as it's precious to him.

Near Power Pipe Ruins on the Fallen Arm,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Sword of Promise[/System:Color].
Return to Caral.

You found and returned the Sword of Promise. Caral[XENO:n ]
seems to have resolved to honour his vow once more.

The exhaust system is due for its ten-year inspection.[XENO:n ]
But she has a bad feeling about this one.[XENO:n ]
Go check the exhaust system in her place.

Eliminate the cause of her unease[XENO:n ]
inside the Ether Exhaust System on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Jeki.

Machine God Soldiers were inside the Ether Exhaust System.[XENO:n ]
You spared Jeki from danger.

He can't handle the gun made with the latest technology.[XENO:n ]
He won't be able to keep the village safe like this.[XENO:n ]
Secure the area in his place.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Offensive Seeker Units[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Caelum Volff[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Lelepago Pterix[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Kyles.

You secured the village in Kyles' place,[XENO:n ]
but Kyles seems to have doubts about the weapon.

Kyles gave up on using the state-of-the-art gun.[XENO:n ]
They decided to make a gun suited to themselves instead.[XENO:n ]
Gather materials so they can defend themselves.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Reinforced Thrusters[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from M91/DOGMA in Machine God Field.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Advanced Frames[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from M53/THANK in Central Factory.
Return to Kyles.

The gun they made to suit themselves works well.[XENO:n ]
They gave you the high-tech gun they no longer need.

Various stresses are causing Ein to act and speak oddly.[XENO:n ]
Everyone in the village is worried about him.[XENO:n ]
Listen to Ein and help solve his problems.
Speak with Ein.
Speak with Ein.
Speak with Ein.
Speak with Ein.
Return to Elena.
You listened patiently to Ein, and he felt better.

Her parents are quarrelling over a broken keepsake.[XENO:n ]
She wants to stop the quarrel somehow.[XENO:n ]
Talk to her parents to learn about the keepsake.

Ask Minis' father, Kyles,[XENO:n ]
what he needs and obtain it.

Ask Minis' mother, Euphoria,[XENO:n ]
what she needs and obtain it.
Return to Minis.

Once the keepsake was fixed, her parents made up[XENO:n ]
and the family was smiling again as they used to.

Two materials are needed for the repairs.[XENO:n ]
He forgot one, but remembers the other.[XENO:n ]
Gather the Flier Bloom Scales needed for the repair.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Flier Bloom Scales[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Happiness Fliers on the Fallen Arm.

You obtained the Flier Bloom Scales[XENO:n ]
needed to repair the keepsake.

Two materials are needed for the repairs.[XENO:n ]
She forgot one, but remembers the other.[XENO:n ]
Gather the Bronze Wood needed for the repair.

Obtain 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Bronze Wood[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Machine God Field.

You obtained the Bronze Wood[XENO:n ]
needed to repair the keepsake.

Natalia brings bento to the guards outside the village,[XENO:n ]
but she seems to tire easily lately.[XENO:n ]
Deliver a bento to Theo in her place.

Deliver the bento to Theo[XENO:n ]
near the base of the index finger.
Take the Lower-Layer Romag to Natalia.

You delivered the bento to Theo[XENO:n ]
safely, taking Natalia's place.

Tear of the Sky appears at the Fallen Arm's fingertips[XENO:n ]
only in bad weather. He needs it but fears heights.[XENO:n ]
Find it for him.

On the Fallen Arm, at Horizon's Toe,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Tear of the Sky[/System:Color] (thunderstorm only).
Return to Calbora.

You obtained the Tear of the Sky for Calbora.[XENO:n ]
But it seems he has another request[XENO:line ]?

Bozerone seems to be at Machina Refuge in Machine God Field.[XENO:n ]
Fear of heights again stands in the way of Calbora's love.[XENO:n ]
Deliver the Tear of the Sky to Bozerone for him.
Take the Tear of the Sky to Bozerone.

Bozerone apparently can't return to the village yet,[XENO:n ]
but was delighted to receive the Tear of the Sky.

Fiorung was inside the silver Machine God Soldier.[XENO:n ]
She's unconscious, but she still has a pulse![XENO:n ]
You want to do something to ease her suffering, but[XENO:line ]

Investigate the beach and get some water[XENO:n ]
for Fiorung.
You collected some Clean Water.

Shulk's group split up in the chaos of the fortress collapse.[XENO:n ]
They fell from the great sword onto an unfamiliar beach.[XENO:n ]
Their friends must be somewhere in the area.
Find your missing companions.
Find the rest of your friends.
You safely reunited with all your companions.

According to Linada, Fiorung needs a circulation system[XENO:n ]
installed for her treatment, but she's missing[XENO:n ]
the Piezoelectric Unit needed to control it.

At Little Finger Beach on the Fallen Arm,[XENO:n ]
find a [System:Color name=item ]Piezoelectric Unit[/System:Color] in Machine God Soldier wreckage.

Find Linada at Junks[XENO:n ]
and give her the [System:Color name=item ]Piezoelectric Unit[/System:Color].

You have given the Piezoelectric Unit to Linada.[XENO:n ]
Fiorung should be OK now.
